interest: Index on Japanese traders undercutting American commerce in Morocco.
overview: Cross-reference (1933): Prince Mehdi El Glaoui reports Japanese agents in Morocco were undermining American trade and stirring anti-American sentiment.

people.name: Mehdi El Glaoui
people.role: Prince of Morocco, son of Pasha El Glaoui, completing military education in France

subfiles.about: Cross-reference sheet noting a report on Japanese commercial agents displacing American trade and fomenting anti-American sentiment in Morocco.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to a 1933 report: Prince Mehdi El Glaoui says Japanese agents in Morocco sought to replace American trade.
subfiles.title: Cross-Reference Sheet for Despatch W.D. 1312 from Dawson (France) on Japanese Anti-American Activities in Morocco
